reserves.name: Cash at Regulated Financial Institutions (net settlement adjustments)

reserveReview.reviewer: D02 evidence renewal 2026-10-27, independently reproduced September examination arithmetic
reserveReview.rationale: The complete September 30, 2026 examination, signed October 26, 2026, reports USD 73,956,687,701 of reserve assets. Treasury fair values are USD 25,361,578,416 in the fund plus USD 1,757,678,272 outside it, totaling USD 27,119,256,688. Overnight Treasury repurchase agreements are USD 36,654,000,000. Net cash and settlement balances are USD 1,003,847,741 - USD 552,000,382 + USD 9,502,194,346 + USD 229,389,308 = USD 10,183,431,013. Each percentage is independently calculated as its amount divided by USD 73,956,687,701 times 100, rounded to eight decimal places; the three amounts reconcile exactly. The latest listed Treasury maturity is December 31, 2026, 92 days after the report date. Settlement adjustments are reported cash due to or owed by Circle, not an invented residual. The examination does not disclose a SIFI/non-SIFI split, so aggregate bank cash has one conservative common-mode issuer domain. The live adapter uses the same aggregate bank key and retains its weekly split only as contextual metadata.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Complete September 30, 2026 examined USD fair-value balances; independently reproduced arithmetic
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All reported reserve assets are classified as Treasury securities, overnight Treasury repos, or net cash and settlement balances. Individual banks, bank shares, and repo counterparties are not disclosed. Aggregate bank exposure is one concentration domain, with no diversification credit inferred from institution categories.

Circle USDC Terms (Segregated Accounts held on behalf of and for the benefit of users)

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Circle's 2025 Form 10-K states approximately 88% of USDC reserves sat in the BlackRock-managed Circle Reserve Fund (SEC-registered 2a-7 government money market fund) whose assets are held in the custody of BNY as of 2025-12-31; the remainder is cash at global banks, primarily systemically important institutions, whose individual names and shares are undisclosed. The 10-K states reserves are held in accounts titled FBO holders of USDC and that Circle does not lend, borrow against, or encumber the reserves, with applicable state regimes prohibiting lending, pledging, rehypothecating, or otherwise encumbering them. The same filing cautions that no court has ruled on stablecoin reserve treatment in an issuer bankruptcy, so bankruptcy remoteness stays contractual-only; custodian-failure replacement terms remain undisclosed.
